description: An environment's state: its live version, its addresses, its health, its services, its recent traffic; include: its live while.yaml (while_yaml), its known vulnerabilities and the bots seen (vulnerabilities), or who opened the app, when and how (openings).

include.description: An extra view on top of the state: while_yaml, vulnerabilities or openings.

probe.description: false: without probing (does not wake a sleeping service).

renew_keep_link.description: true: a new claim link, and the one given before stops working. Without this parameter, the link that is still valid.

since.description: vulnerabilities: the window of bots seen in the traffic; openings: the window of openings, 7d without since (30m, 6h, 7d…).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: get_app_status
title: Read an app's status
